risk: A trigger on the Invoice table touches every money write in the system: a buggy trigger breaks billing writes, not just the list. Mitigations: the function is small, delta-based and fully covered by the invariant integration test (including concurrency and reassignment); the migration is additive with a one-transaction cutover; rollback is drop trigger + drop column with no data loss (invoices are untouched). Write contention: same-customer invoice writes serialize on the customer row lock — bounded, per-customer, and the codebase already locks rows on money writes.
